WORDS: Happy new year everyone! Welcome to the year 2011!
2010 ended on December 31st!
Umm…Scrape Cat, I think there must be something inside your tummy!
What is it Tinker Cat?
It's a baby boy!
Well, If you wanna see a baby inside my tummy, I'm not sure if it's a boy or a girl!
Anyways, Can you take me to the hospital?
Sure!
At the hospital...
Congrats! It's a baby boy! What would you like to name your baby?
I know! I'll name him Scratch Kitty!
He is so adorable! I can't believe he's ours!
Yeah! When we get home, we're going to be good parents!
The next month…
Oh my god! Scratch Kitty, How did you grew up?
It was my birthday 2 days ago.
Scratch Kitten, This is not your room! This is my room! Go to your own room!
Does this room belong to me?
No, it belongs to me!
Fine! I'll go to my own room now!
That's more like it!
Gosh…It's midnight! I better go to sleep right now!
Wake up! Breakfast is ready!
Okay mom!
Dad, Can I have some fried eggs and muffin for breakfast?
Sure!
During March, We can all go to the airport and take the airplane to fly to hotel!
On March…
OKAY, is everyone here?
Yes!
Good! Let's go explore some places!

WORDS: Who's background is this?
That's my background. It's the same colour as me!
Hey guys! We found the waterpark! Let's hurry up before the bad guys get here!
We e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e e!
This stupid waterpark sounds horrible! I'm changing the water into lava!
OH NO! THE WATER TURNED INTO LAVA! WHAT DO WE DO?!
I DON'T KNOW! BUT I THINK WE'RE BOTH GONNA DIE!
And now the water is back to normal, I will count by twos like this:
You added a 43!
I'm terribly sorry.
On April…
What's wrong? Are you okay? Did you guys eat something?
We ate easter eggs because we were hungry.
You 3 need to eat something good for your bodies instead of chocolate Easter eggs!
What do you mean Dad?
How about you eat healthy food?
That's a good idea! Let's go!
Before that, I will count by fives like this:
Salamander
You added a salamander.
Sorry!
Hey guys! My name is Nona and I am Nina's big sister! I came here because I wasn't here!
Hi big sister! Nice to see you!
Nina, Who's your big sister?
Nona is my big sister!
The next month…
Hello everyone! And welcome to the racing competition-
Hey Red Team, Guess what? I wanna tell you something!
What is it?
It's mother's day! That means I'm going to give my mom a present!
Wow, Really? Will you help me?
Sure! Let's get the post cards!
Scratch Kitten and Nina…
What are you girls doing here?
We're planning a mother's day gift.
Alphabet Lore F, Are you excited to celebrate mother's day with us?
NO! I HATE MOTHER'S DAY!
Uhh…F, Why did you eat the Green Team?
THEY FORCED ME TO LIKE MOTHER'S DAY!
BAD NEWS!
What is it Spooky Spoon?
Alphabet Lore F ate two teams! Turn him back to normal now!
Thank you! They almost got us!
On June…
Hey guys! I found a swimming pool! Do you all wanna join me?
Sure! This is going to be so much fun!
Guys, Wanna have a swimming race?
NO! INSTEAD, I WILL TURN THE POOL INTO BLOOD!
Adrien and Aubrey, What happened to the water?
It turned into blood! This needs a fix.
Robot Flower and Bell, Who fixed the swimming pool?
It was Aubrey! Hooray for Aubrey!
And since the water is back to normal, I will count by tens like this:
Forty
You said forty in words.
Sorry, my bad.
Alphablock J, Don't you no longer have your beak?
